feeText: Uniform fee for initiating any cause of action in circuit court, including domestic cases: $165.00 (Ark. Code §§ 21-6-402, 21-6-403, as listed on the Pulaski County Circuit Clerk's court filings fee schedule). Reopening a cause of action: $50.00.

residency.text: The Pulaski County Circuit Clerk states that a person must have lived in Arkansas for 60 days before filing for divorce (residence rule of Ark. Code § 9-12-307).
